<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
pack_params(plan: PackPlan, params: Mapping[str, np.ndarray]) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.pack`](/api/evoxc-hf/pack/)

Also available as `evoxc_hf.pack_params`.

Pack a canonical host params tree with `plan` (shorthand for `plan.pack`).

## Parameters

- `plan` · `PackPlan` — the `PackPlan` built from the same family's `param_specs`.

- `params` · `Mapping[str, np.ndarray]` — canonical params, host arrays (dtype/shape must match the plan).

## Returns

- `dict[str, np.ndarray]` — dict[str, np.ndarray]: the packed host tree a `pack_weights=True` executable takes.

## Raises

- `TypeError` — `plan` is not a `PackPlan`, or `params` is not a
  mapping.

- `HFWeightError` — a key is missing/extra, or a value has the wrong
  dtype/shape (the message names the key).
